scope: Pure schema/identity/validation boundaries; browser interactions are tested separately.

checks.name: Schema rejects invalid names, duplicates, unknown types and invalid sections
Empty schema stays empty and caller-owned configuration is not mutated
Defaults retain zero, false, empty arrays and repeater values
Conditional visibility and dependent options respect actual data
Synchronous rules preserve numeric zero and enforce range, step and required
Email, URL, regex and cross-field dates fail meaningfully
Richtext validation counts plain text and recognizes empty markup
Table validates nested identity and rejects incompatible variable-height virtual modes
Nested headers flatten only leaves, and sort handles nulls and numeric text
Table config never mutates the caller rows or columns
Public renderers escape schema/table labels and editable richtext source
